set -u
mkdir -p "$OUT/dump" "$OUT/archive"
vol --offline -s /tmp/dfirswarm-batman-ii-preparation/home/packs/memory-forensics/vendor/symbols -f inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw -q -o "$OUT/dump" windows.dumpfiles --virtaddr 0xab0b10cde210 > "$OUT/volatility-dumpfiles.txt" 2> "$OUT/volatility-stderr.txt"
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
out=Path(os.environ['OUT'])
fs=list((out/'dump').glob('*Inbox.dat'))
if not fs: raise SystemExit('no Inbox.dat dumped')
p=fs[0]; d=p.read_bytes()
mid=b'Message-ID: <d3a63f93-a0ee-4718-a71a-d9646de2698b@gmail.com>'
i=d.find(mid)
if i<0: raise SystemExit('target Message-ID absent')
beg=d.rfind(b'From - ',0,i); end=d.find(b'\nFrom - ',i)
mb=d[beg:end if end>=0 else None]
(out/'confidential.eml').write_bytes(mb)
first=mb.find(b'\n')
msg=BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parsebytes(mb[first+1:])
parts=[]
for part in msg.walk():
    payload=part.get_payload(decode=True) or b''
    row={'type':part.get_content_type(),'filename':part.get_filename(),'disposition':part.get_content_disposition(),'decoded_bytes':len(payload),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() if payload else None}
    if part.get_filename():
        (out/part.get_filename()).write_bytes(payload)
    elif part.get_content_type()=='text/plain':
        row['text']=payload.decode(part.get_content_charset() or 'utf-8','replace')
    parts.append(row)
summary={'source_dump':p.name,'mbox_offset':beg,'message_id':str(msg['Message-ID']),'from':str(msg['From']),'to':str(msg['To']),'subject':str(msg['Subject']),'date':str(msg['Date']),'parts':parts}
(out/'message-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
PY
7z l -slt "$OUT/contact.rar" > "$OUT/archive-list.txt" 2> "$OUT/archive-list-stderr.txt" || true
7z x -y -o"$OUT/archive" "$OUT/contact.rar" > "$OUT/archive-extract.txt" 2> "$OUT/archive-extract-stderr.txt" || true
find "$OUT/archive" -type f -printf '%P\t%s\t' -exec sha256sum {} \; > "$OUT/archive-extracted-manifest.tsv"
cat "$OUT/message-summary.json"
